response:
FADE IN:

EXT. KINGDOM - DAY

The camera pans over a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor and ladies in flowing gowns hurrying about their daily business. But amidst the chaos, a sense of unease settles over the land. The king, a stout and proud man with a thick beard, sits upon his throne, his eyes fixed on a strange and wondrous object in front of him.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king, KING ARTHUR, gazes upon a sleek, silver laptop, adorned with flashing lights and pulsing colors. He looks at it with a mixture of confusion and fascination.

KING ARTHUR
(to his advisor, SIR EDWARD)
What sorcery is this? How does it work?

SIR EDWARD
Your Majesty, this is a... a... (he consults a nearby book)...a "computer".

KING ARTHUR
(intrigued)
A machine that can store and retrieve information? By the saints, this is a marvel!

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - LATER

King Arthur begins to explore the laptop, marveling at the strange and wondrous things it can do. He creates a new document, filled with cryptic symbols and garbled text.

KING ARTHUR
(to Sir Edward)
Behold! I have created a new language, one that will be the hallmark of our empire's greatness!

SIR EDWARD
(nervously)
Uh, Your Majesty, perhaps we should stick to the traditional methods of communication?

KING ARTHUR
(firmly)
No, no, Sir Edward. This is the future. And I will be its master.

CUT TO:

EXT. KINGDOM - DAY

As the days pass, the kingdom begins to transform. The knights wear neon-colored armor, and the ladies adorn themselves in flowing, pastel-colored gowns. The streets are filled with the sound of distant, warped synthesizers, and the air is thick with the scent of incense and ozone.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Arthur sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors and courtiers. They all wear strange, futuristic attire, and their faces are painted with intricate, swirling patterns.

KING ARTHUR
(to the assembly)
My dear subjects, I have a vision for our empire's future. A future of... of... (he consults a nearby document)...of "vaporwave".

The courtiers look at each other in confusion, but King Arthur presses on.

KING ARTHUR
We will build a kingdom of neon lights and distorted sounds, of glitchy, pixelated images. We will be the masters of the digital realm, and all shall bow to our greatness!

The courtiers applaud, and the camera zooms out to reveal a sprawling, dystopian landscape, filled with towering skyscrapers and endless, featureless plains.

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
